name: explore_world_waters
description: A deterministic bilingual real-world fishing and ecology field journal. Travel through real habitats, inspect water conditions, identify native and introduced species, automatically release protected fish, observe rather than catch birds/mammals/invertebrates/plants, deepen repeated observations, unlock ecological relationships, record corrections, and encounter location-specific natural objects, debris, or empty casts. Prefer batch casts with times and stop_on. Every result ends with a compact status JSON line.

choice.description: For identify: answer option number, starting at 1. Omit to show the field-mark exercise.

language.description: For language: persist Chinese or English interface mode.

bait_id.description: For buy/cast. Cast omits bait_id to use the cheapest available bait.

times.description: For cast: deterministic repeated casts, compactly summarized.

stop_on.description: Stop repeated casts on a new species, rare-or-better observation, or non-fish field event.

target.description: For sell: catch id, all, or species <fish_id>. Release-only wildlife never enters inventory.

location_id.description: For goto: canonical real-world location id. Omit to list the world map.

fish_id.description: For identify: id of a species already observed.

id.description: For look: species, location, or bait id/name. Unobserved species remain hidden.

steps.description: For batch: up to 8 action objects.
